blockers.title: The plural 'Istruttori' used as a form label still starts the staff section and drops every student after it with no notice: left blank, split from its names, or naming instructors whose surnames are heading words. 5c1e029 read all of these students
blockers.scenario: Probe round8/r8d, compared with 5c1e029, fake date 2026-09-27. Text sheet: Bardino, Verdi, then the label, then Rossa, Neri. With 'Istruttori:', 'Istruttori: ________', 'Istruttori di turno:', 'Istruttori: Sabato', 'Istruttori: Sabato e Corso', 'Istruttori di turno: Corso' or 'Istruttori: Domenica, Sabato', the current parser returns only Bardino and Verdi. Rossa and Neri disappear with no notice, and the camera path has no count confirmation. OCR split: 'Istruttori:' on one line and 'Verdani Luca, Galli Sara' on the next drops the students after it. The same happens with 'Istruttori:' and the names in separate TSV blocks on one laid-out row: 3 of 5 students are lost. Sheet grouped by instructor: after 'Istruttore: Verdani' and group 1, the line 'Istruttori: Sabato' drops all of group 2. At the top ('Corso Deriva 2', then the label, then students) the result is 0 candidates, marked unsuitable. 'Corso Istruttori' as a title does the same (r7x-rerun). 5c1e029 read every one of these students READY, because its istruttr(ore|ori) typo never matched 'istruttori'. This is F1R7-1 in the plural. The round-7 fix covers only singular role words. staffLine still counts heading words (Sabato, Corso, Domenica) as heading material, although round 7 warned against removing heading words from the count. Next steps says a collective heading drops rows only 'with filler words only', and 'Istruttori: Sabato e Corso' falsifies that. SC-11's 'so no row is dropped on a guess' does not hold for these lines. The same lines with Personale, Assistenti or Istruttrici drop the students at 5c1e029 too, so those are identical.
blockers.suggestedFix: In staffLine, let only collective and filler words make a heading. Heading words are possible surnames, so 'Istruttori: Sabato' and 'Corso Istruttori' become mentions that mark. Treat a collective line that ends in ':' or carries a '_' or '.' fill run as a mention. As a safety net inside the staff section, mark rows possible-staff instead of dropping them when they read as a minor. Add tests for 'Istruttori:', 'Istruttori di turno: ____', 'Istruttori: Sabato e Corso', and a label split from its names (text and TSV), each at the top and between students.

importantFindings.title: A label that pairs a label word with a singular staff word that 5c1e029 recognised is skipped alone, so role-less staff rows under it are READY with no mark. 5c1e029 dropped them
importantFindings.scenario: Probe r8a 'foot' and 'top+staff+Allievi'. Four students, then 'Nome assistente:', 'Firma assistente', 'Firma istruttrice', 'Nome volontario', 'Note assistente', 'Data firma istruttrice', 'Assistente: Neri Firma' or 'Cognome Nome Nascita Assistente', then 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni' and 'Galli Sara 05/05/1995 31 anni'. Both staff rows are READY with rowWarning none. 5c1e029 dropped both, because 'assistente', 'istruttrice' and 'volontario' matched its section pattern. An example is a small staff table at the foot headed 'Nome assistente | Nascita | Telefono'. This needs staff rows printed without a role code, the same class as F1R7-2. For 'Firma istruttore' and 'Nome istruttore:' the output is identical to 5c1e029.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Keep column headers skipped alone at the top. When a label with a staff word comes after a row that reads as a student (the foot of the sheet), mark the rows after it possible-staff, as the contact-line rule already does. Add a test with 'Nome assistente:' above staff rows.

importantFindings.title: F1R7-4 is only partly fixed: 'Centro Velico 12 anni' is still READY with no mark. 5c1e029 dropped it, and the self-review records F1R7-4 as fixed
importantFindings.scenario: Probes r8b and r7x-rerun 'BL heading'. 'Centro Velico 12 anni' and 'CENTRO VELICO 12 anni', on text and laid out, become 'Centro|Velico|12|none|READY'. isHeadingWord tests single words, and NON_STUDENT_LINE_PATTERN's 'centro\s+velico' needs two words, so neither word matches. The table path has the same gap: 'Centro Velico' with a date that could be a birth date, or with a telephone and an age, is READY. 5c1e029 dropped all of these, because it tested the whole leading text. 'Turno Domenica', 'Gruppo Corso', 'N. 3 Corso Vela', 'II Settimana Deriva' and 'A - Corso Vela' are now marked. 'Centro Velico 12 anni' was one of the three laid-out lines named in F1R7-4, so the 'fixed' status overclaims. Rated important, as in round 7: the heading is constructed.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: In the age branch and the table branch, also test NON_STUDENT_LINE_PATTERN against words.join(' ') (and nameWords.join(' ')). Add a test for 'Centro Velico 12 anni', and correct the F1R7-4 disposition.

importantFindings.title: The staff-line bullet in next steps does not describe the code, and it errs in the unsafe direction
importantFindings.scenario: (a) It says a collective heading drops rows 'with filler words only'. The code also accepts heading words, so 'Personale CVC', 'Staff Corso', 'Personale: Cognome Nome', 'Istruttori: Sabato e Corso' and the column header 'Cognome Nome Nascita Telefono personale' all drop the rows after them. The header case is identical to 5c1e029, but it is unlisted. (b) It says 'Any other line with a staff word and no date, age or telephone … marks the rows after it'. Labels ('Firma istruttore', 'Nome istruttore:', 'Cognome Nome Nascita Istruttore') are skipped alone and mark nothing: tests at studentScan.test.ts:1565-1574, and F1R8-2. (c) The word list omits Istruttrici and Volontarie. The code comment at studentScan.ts:969-976 and SC-11 describe (a) correctly. The heading-word bullet (:100-108) now matches classifyLine (checked for ranges, the table date rule and the crop rule).
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Reword to match staffLine: heading means collective plus filler or heading words; a label with a label word and no collective word is skipped alone and marks nothing; the full collective list. Or change the code per F1R8-1 and F1R8-2, then describe that.

importantFindings.title: The F1R7-3 contact-line fix only takes effect after allievi, studenti or partecipanti: with 'Iscritti' or 'Corsisti' as the student heading, staff rows under a contact line are READY with no mark
importantFindings.scenario: Probe r8a 'top+staff+Iscritti'. The sheet reads 'Personale tel. 3331234567', 'Staff 3331234567', 'Segreteria 0212345678' or 'Assistente Neri 36 anni', then two role-less staff rows, then 'Iscritti', then students. Verdani and Galli are READY with no mark. 5c1e029 dropped them, and it also dropped every student, so it reported the sheet unsuitable. The same sheet with 'Allievi' is marked correctly. 'Iscritti' is a common Italian heading for a participant list, and it does not end a staff section either.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Add iscritti, corsisti and similar words to STUDENT_SECTION_PATTERN, with a test for the contact line followed by 'Iscritti'.

qolFindings.title: 'Volontaria' is not a staff word, so role-less staff rows after 'Volontaria Croce Rossa' stay READY, as at 5c1e029
qolFindings.scenario: Probe r7x-rerun 'C foot Volontaria Croce Rossa': the output is identical to 5c1e029, and the staff rows are READY with no mark. volontari[eo]? followed by \b cannot match 'volontaria'. The round-7 suggested fix named 'volontario/a'.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Use volontari[aeo]? and add a test.
